build_fgsm_attack: build a PGD-based FGSM adversarial attack using IteratedFGSM optimizer with l-infinity perturbation
build_adam_attack: build an adversarial attack using Adam optimizer with piecewise constant learning rate schedule
create_untargeted_attack: create an UntargetedAttack instance combining PGD with cross-entropy loss to generate adversarial examples
create_linf_projection: create an l-infinity projection function that clips perturbations within epsilon and input bounds
compute_untargeted_margin: compute the margin loss between true class logits and highest non-true logits
